QUOTE: It calls `llama_token_to_piece` with a 256-byte stack buffer and, if that returns a negative size, reallocates to the exact size and calls again.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states detokenize tries a 256-byte stack buffer first and reallocates only when it doesn't fit, and contrasts this with tokenize's size-probe call that runs first on every invocation.
